params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY systemId ORDER BY SystemModifiedAt DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.systemId = D.systemId

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.SystemModifiedAt IS NULL OR D.SystemModifiedAt > T.SystemModifiedAt
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  entryNumber                = D.entryNumber,
  sourcePostingGroup         = D.sourcePostingGroup,
  valuedByAverageCost        = D.valuedByAverageCost,
  jobNumber                  = D.jobNumber,
  jobTaskNumber              = D.jobTaskNumber,

  invoicedQuantity           = D.invoicedQuantity,
  purchaseAmountActual       = D.purchaseAmountActual,

  costPerUnit                = D.costPerUnit,

  costAmountNonInvtblACY     = D.costAmountNonInvtblACY,
  expectedCostPostedToGL     = D.expectedCostPostedToGL,
  expCostPostedToGLACY       = D.expCostPostedToGLACY,
  salesAmountActual          = D.salesAmountActual,
  itemNumber                 = D.itemNumber,

  sourceNumber               = D.sourceNumber,
  PB365TRLineType            = D.PB365TRLineType,
  PB365TRRebinKforLNo        = D.PB365TRRebinKforLNo,
  PB365TRSourceHierCode      = D.PB365TRSourceHierCode,
  variantCode                = D.variantCode,
  PB365MASubcICEntry         = D.PB365MASubcICEntry,
  genBusPostingGroup         = D.genBusPostingGroup,

  costPerUnitACY             = D.costPerUnitACY,
  documentType               = D.documentType,
  locationCode               = D.locationCode,
  documentLineNumber         = D.documentLineNumber,

  expectedCost               = D.expectedCost,
  itemChargeNumber           = D.itemChargeNumber

VALUES (
